body: Under the Haldane County floodplain ordinance, a building in the special flood hazard area whose cost to repair equals or exceeds 50 percent of its market value before the damage must be brought into compliance before it is repaired. This usually means raising the lowest floor to the required elevation.

You may not start permanent repairs until your office of permits has reviewed a plan. Emergency work to protect the building from further damage, such as drying out and removing wet materials, may begin now.
Your flood insurance policy may include Increased Cost of Compliance coverage. Contact your insurance agent about a claim.
fields.appeal: You may ask for a review within 30 days by contacting our office with your own repair estimate or an appraisal.
